map_features.note: Northwestward surface North Brazil regional branch from an OSW gate near the source-described 5 S origin to a nominal 7 N retroflection approach. Alternative terminal conventions stop at 5 or 9 N. Excludes upstream North Brazil Undercurrent, offshore retroflected return branch, NECC/EUC continuations, Guiana continuation and detached ring tracks or perimeters. No whole circulation-system length asserted.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km as in the existing reference-route state join; planar relation to coarse masked OSW display polygons.
